mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS declining below 4.0% over the prior 6 months, or Rank IC <0.05 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 7.0% triggers expectations of weak labor demand, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >50% of triggered instances despite UNRATE exceeding 7.0% for 3 consecutive months, or IC >0.15 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (demand) signal robust economic activity, boosting equity valuations through expanded profit margins and capital investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite GDPC1 and RSAFS rising above their 3-month moving averages, or IC <0.1 over any 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, low CPIAUCSL inflation (below 2.0%) suggests the Fed will maintain accommodative policy, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative over 60d horizon despite CPIAUCSL remaining below 2.0% for 6 consecutive months, or IC <0.05 over any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >70% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% for 3 months, or IC >0.2 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 98.5 indicates contracting business capacity, reducing corporate investment and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive over 20d horizon despite INDPRO remaining below 98.5 for 4 consecutive months, or IC <0.1 over any 8-week window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor demand) alongside FEDFUNDS signals strong employment growth and accommodative policy, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite both PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS rising above their 3-month moving averages, or IC <0.15 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.5% triggers expectations of weak labor market growth, reducing corporate investment and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive over 60d horizon despite UNRATE exceeding 6.5% for 4 consecutive months, or IC >0.2 over any 6-month window.
